title: Chapter 451 Preparing To Build A Nation
content:
Chapter 451 Preparing To Build A Nation

In the following period of time, the three giants of Dahuai Domain began to reorganize the entire force and strengthen management.

At present, the external threats of Dahuai Domain seem to have been eliminated, but they have fallen into the eyes of a higher-level empire.

Just like ginseng in the wild, when it grows big enough, it is time to be harvested by others.

Now the forces in Dahuai Domain are complicated and roughly divided into three forces.

If the power problem is not solved, it may be detrimental to the later development.

Zhao Bangde sees this problem more clearly than anyone else.

At this time, he has also adjusted his mentality.

Wang Shuo has saved Dahuai Domain several times and made great contributions.

Although he treated Wang Shuo very well in the early stage when he had not grown up, now the backbone of Dahuai Domain has become Wang Shuo.

Especially in the few months when he was away, Dahuai Domain developed in an orderly manner.

Zhao Bangde is not obsessed with power.

So he found Zhu Dongheng and discussed this matter.

Zhu Dongheng was originally in an absolute disadvantage, and he had no objection to this. After all, the territory is too large now, and the conditions for building an empire have been met.

On this day, Zhao Bangde and Zhu Dongheng took the initiative to find Wang Shuo and talked about establishing an empire.

Wang Shuo felt that the time was ripe when he heard it.

If you want to establish a country, you must elect an emperor.

Wang Shuo was very grateful to Zhao Bangde, so he took the initiative to ask Zhao Bangde to be the emperor of the new empire.

But Zhao Bangde analyzed the reality and made Wang Shuo the emperor, which was the most suitable for the actual situation of Dahuai Territory.

"Wang Shuo, you don't have to refuse."

"Whether it is your strength or the people's hearts, you can lead us to survive better."

Wang Shuo could not refuse and could only accept it.

"Old Zhao, Old Zhu, even if I become the emperor, you are indispensable to the development of the entire empire. Why don't you, Old Zhao, serve as the national teacher and Old Zhu, serve as the prime minister."

The two did not refuse.

These three positions are the three most powerful positions in the entire empire.

In this way, the three positions of a huge empire were born in the discussion of the three people.

"What should we call our empire?"

"I think this question should be decided by our emperor." Zhao Bangde laughed.

Wang Shuo was a little embarrassed. His villages were named after nearby mountains.

It was really difficult for him to name an empire.

"Old Zhao, Old Zhu, you two give me some advice! I'm really not good at this kind of thing."

"Haha, it's better for your majesty to decide on such a major matter as naming the country!"

After that, the two left with a smile.

To establish an empire, there are many things to deal with.

Wang Shuo handed them all over to Zhu Dongheng.

Zhu Dongheng had served as an official in a large empire before, so he had some experience.

So, the entire territory was preparing for the establishment of a country.

Now the Shenwu Empire is too busy to take care of itself. The nearest fourth-level empire, the Daro Empire, is not as strong as Wang Shuo and his team.

And they are also too busy to take care of themselves at this time, and have no energy to care about Wang Shuo and his team.

Even no envoys were sent to question them.

At present, the Daluo Empire has only one strongest king. After learning that Naris was conquered by the Great Sophora Domain, he dared not even fart.

Although the Roland Empire and the Daluo Empire in the north of the Great Sophora Domain did not care about the Great Sophora Domain.

But there are always strong people who are obsessed with the Great Sophora Domain.

For example, the Sword God.
